notes.title: New update: Story Mode and Steam Cloud Save!
notes.notes:
Hello summer lovers,

To start the school year on the right track, we're coming with an update! We've carefully read your feedback and tried to respond the best we can with an update and a few guides. We've added the Steam Cloud Save, and a "story mode" where you can't instant-win the combat!


Patchnote
Added

Steam Cloud Save

During combat, an instant win button

During combat, a new pop-up

Fixed/Balancing

Increased the amount of relationship points gained to unlock relationship episodes more easily

Main content videos unlocked in the gallery app

Updated credits text

Removed some extra text for some sentences in the Brazilian language


Guides
We've also created a few guides to help you in your stellar journey ✨

Relationship mechanics

If you're curious about how the relationship system works in Nova Hearts, here are some insights and a little explanation on how to unlock some hidden selfies and hot pics 🔥

[dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3537418389"][/dynamiclink]

Final boss fight

We heard that our last boss (whoever it is 👀) is not the easiest to beat! So here are some tips to defeat it!

[dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3537474587"][/dynamiclink]
Fan arts
We've also seen a few fan arts that warmed our hearts, so we also wanted to share them with you 💖

Pixel Art Will by LesBeanz

notes.title: What's in the next update?
notes.notes:
An update is on the way for the first chapter The Spark!

We've been carefully reading your feedback and thanks to your reports and suggestions, a few things will be updated! This update will come in the first week of March.

Here is our plan for this update:

 Fasten the conversation in the Message App
 Modify the combat pacing to have fewer combats and fasten them
 Specify the intentions behind dialogue choices
 Many other quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44835526/ee86b59158ef5f035b6f376213c05b2623112fd5.png

Thanks to YOU, we can improve this game, so don't hesitate to share your feedback and suggestions in the Steam discussions.

What would you like to see improved in the game?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44835526/56262a94a678b34caa2847e767430ae62378782b.png

notes.title: New release date for first chapter "The Spark"
notes.notes:
The first chapter Nova Hearts: The Spark will be officially playable for free on January 25, 4pm CET / 7am PST.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/7eee66f2d605d39d3cc6a4254adc625bcf384d73.png

The full game will then be playable in 2025.

In this first chapter, you play Luce, a positive and funny 21yo who loves being around her friends and helping others. You're back in this city you left some years ago. Discover more about your new life, new old friends, and powers!

[previewyoutube=UFjAvu_0_jw;full][/previewyoutube]
Support us, don’t forget to wishlist Nova Hearts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2506290/Nova_hearts/

We can't wait to know what you think of the game, its characters and soul!
